key_insight: OphIn-500K is a comprehensive dataset designed to enhance ophthalmic multimodal large language models for clinical applications.
clinical_relevance: This work addresses the lack of large-scale, specialized data for ophthalmology, facilitating better conversational assistants for clinical diagnosis.
method: Developed OphIn-Engine for curating high-quality instruction data from web-scale ophthalmology videos.
Generated over 500,000 instruction instances and 151,000 unique images using VQA, multi-turn interactions, and CoT reasoning.
Created OphIn-VL, an ophthalmology-specific MLLM with enhanced visual and conversational capacities.
evidence_signal: OphIn-500K comprises over 500,000 instruction instances derived from more than 29,000 video clips.
watch_item: The reliance on open-access video content may introduce variability in data quality and relevance.
paper_title: OphIn-500K: Curating Web-Scale Visual Instructions for Scaling Ophthalmic Multimodal Large Language Models
